alert: IRCFiber host memory available critically low

annotations.summary: Host MemAvailable below threshold on ovh-prod
annotations.description: MemAvailable stayed under the threshold for the whole evaluation window. On 2026-09-06 an on-host D compile drove this to 117 MB of 7.565 GiB, after which dockerd stopped answering and ircfiber.com went down with no alert. Steady state is mongo 2.77 GiB + gateway 137 MiB + engine 109 MiB + caddy 52 MiB + the small sidecars, so a sustained dip under ~700 MiB means something new is eating the box. Check: docker stats --no-stream; free -m; ps aux --sort=-rss | head. Never build on the prod host — BUILD_HOST in site/Makefile.site compiles on ubuntu-docker. This rule also fires when host metrics stop arriving (alertOnAbsent), which is itself the condition that made the incident invisible.
